name: Mars the great
source: Mars the Great makes a guest appearance in the Alicesoft game Persiom as an adventurer exploring the depths of the Hades Labyrinth that can randomly be encountered upon entering the labyrinth's entrance hall. He is notable for being one of the only guest characters that can be encountered by every playable character, including the Miracle Gang, and will reward the player with the morning star weapon when he is encountered after they have advanced farther into the labyrinth than him. His title on the adventurer ranking board is listed as "Fabulous".
